description:
Map lane: pins near a point (lat/lng + radius_km). `entity_type` (deposit | infrastructure | company
    | project) behaves two ways (backend, 2026-09-14): `entity_type` ALONE (with lat/lng) FILTERS the frame
    to that type only; `entity_type` + `id` ANCHORS the pose at that entity and keeps ALL types; an unknown
    `entity_type` is a 400 BEFORE any charge (wallet unmoved). The `price` block is the breakdown of `charged_joules`. Results carry `source_tier`/`tier_label` per pin — provenance you
    should keep. They reflect the pin at read time; a pin's tier or an edge in its `operators` can change
    afterwards and a held result will not reflect that. `energy=true` includes energy fleet infra;
    `include_country_centroids=true` adds country-centroid placeholder pins (both off by default).Metered: charged to your own wallet — see the server instructions (CHARGING); quote first with `billing_quote`.

energy.description: Include energy-fleet infrastructure (power plants and grid assets). Default false.
energy.title: Energy

entity_type.description: Entity kind: deposit | infrastructure | company | project. Alone (with lat/lng) it FILTERS the frame to that type; with `id` it ANCHORS the pose on that entity and keeps all types.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

id.description: Entity id to anchor the pose on (with entity_type).
id.title: Id

include_country_centroids.description: Also return country-centre placeholder pins (entities known only by country). Default false.
include_country_centroids.title: Include Country Centroids

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, -90 to 90 (WGS84). Use with lng, or pose on an entity instead.
lat.title: Lat

radius_km.description: Search radius around the pose, in km. Default 100.
radius_km.title: Radius Km

name: look_from
